title: zxoar
description: Agent-first trading on the ZXOAR launchpad (Uniswap V4): scan, vet, guarded buy/sell, atomic launch
summary: Agent-first trading on the ZXOAR launchpad (Uniswap V4): scan, vet, guarded buy/sell, atomic launch
offersHint: Agent-first trading on the ZXOAR launchpad (Uniswap V4): scan, vet, guarded buy/sell, atomic launch · Packages: npm:zxoar-mcp · Env vars: MAX_ETH_PER_SESSION, MAX_ETH_PER_TX, MAX_TX_PER_MINUTE, PRIVATE_KEY, RPC_URL

environmentVariables.name: PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional trading key — without it the server is READ-ONLY (scan/vet/info only). Signs locally; never leaves your machine.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_ETH_PER_TX
environmentVariables.description: Server-enforced cap per trade in ETH (default 0.5).

environmentVariables.name: MAX_ETH_PER_SESSION
environmentVariables.description: Server-enforced cumulative session spend cap in ETH (default 2).

environmentVariables.name: MAX_TX_PER_MINUTE
environmentVariables.description: Server-enforced rate limit on state-changing calls (default 12).

environmentVariables.name: RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the chain RPC (defaults to Robinhood Chain mainnet; pair with CHAIN_ID and the *_ADDRESS vars for forks/testnets).
